tests.name: Search for a chair
tests.goal: Find the search box at the top of the page, type 'office chair', and press Enter to search.

expected.description: Search results page shows multiple office chairs with prices and images

tests.name: Add a chair to shopping cart
tests.goal: Search for 'office chair', click on the first search result to open the product page, then click the 'Add to Cart' button.

expected.description: Page confirms the item was added to cart, showing a success message or cart count updated
Cart count should be at least 1
